macros.name: CDfattrue
macros.doc: Double arrows are obtained by inserting \CDfattrue into the diagram before, i.e., to the immediate left of, the arrow that you wish to be doubled.

macros.name: CDlor
macros.doc: The color, a defined xcolor color name, can be added to an arrow by inserting \CDlor{<color >} into the diagram before, i.e., to the immediate left of, the arrow that you wish to color.

envs.name: CD
envs.doc: The amscd package provides a CD environment that emulates the commutative diagram capabilities of AMS-TeX version 2.x.
